note: Rustic state forest campground on the Tomahawk Creek Flooding, 12.5 miles southeast of Onaway via M-33 South and Tomahawk Lake Highway, in two units (east, sites 1-24; west, sites 25-47), both on the flooding. Boat launch at the west unit and an undeveloped carry-in launch at the east unit; known for fishing among submerged timber (panfish, bass, pike, crappie). The High Country Pathway is just down the road; ORVs and snowmobiles may ride between the campground and nearby trails, including the Atlanta Trail. --Claude
summary: DNR page + SF amenity table: $20, no electric, vault toilets, hand-pump water, first-come only, 15-day max, 47 sites in two units for 'tents, small trailers, and large trailers' (all confirmed, derived -> manual). Season changed: derived 'not year-round' -> Apr 1 - Nov 19 (table closure 'Nov 20 to April 1'). Phone 989-733-8279 matches (Onaway SP). Type 'rustic', not equestrian; ORV/snowmobile operation between campground and trails is allowed (Atlanta Trail), but it is not described as an ORV trail camp. Directions carry no road warning; the page's directions point (45.2386,-84.1859) is ~1.5 km N of the pin, which may sit on one unit.
